name: Mémorial Pierre Savorgnan de Brazza
subtitle: The memorial is the mausoleum where the remains of Brazza and his family were reburied in 2006 after being transferred from Algiers.

facts.label: Reburial
facts.value: Remains brought from Algiers in October 2006 and reburied in an imposing marble and glass mausoleum on the banks of the Congo River

facts.label: Who was transferred
facts.value: The remains of Pierre Savorgnan de Brazza and all the members of his family

parts.text: The memorial is the mausoleum where the remains of Brazza and his family were reburied in 2006 after being transferred from Algiers. It stands on the banks of the Congo river.
